SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ordered_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date , SUM(price) AS totalPrice FROM orders WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND order_status IN
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ordered_at, '%Y%m%d')

SELECT O.order_id, O.store_id, O.price, O.order_status, O.ordered_at, P.place_name, P.place_id, M.menu_id, PAY.payment_id, CASE WHEN PAY.payment_type = 'MIX' THEN 'MIX' WHEN MAX(PAY.payment_type) = 'CARD' THEN 'CARD' ELSE 'CASH' END AS paymentType FROM orders O INNER JOIN order_menus OM ON O.order_id = OM.order_id INNER JOIN places P ON O.place_id = P.place_id INNER JOIN payments PAY ON PAY.order_id = O.order_id INNER JOIN menus M ON OM.menu_id = M.menu_id WHERE O.store_id = #{storeId} AND O.order_status IN
AND DATE_FORMAT(ordered_at, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{date} GROUP BY O.order_id ORDER BY O.order_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT ROUND((SUM(price) / COUNT(*)), 2) AS averageValue FROM orders WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND order_status = 'SUCCESS'

SELECT C.category_name, SUM(OM.order_price) AS total_sales FROM order_menus OM INNER JOIN menus M ON OM.menu_id = M.menu_id INNER JOIN categories C ON M.category_id = C.category_id WHERE OM.order_status = 'SUCCESS' AND C.store_id = #{storeID} GROUP BY C.category_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC

SELECT DATE(ordered_at) AS date, CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(ordered_at, '%H'), ':00-', DATE_FORMAT(ordered_at + INTERVAL 1 HOUR, '%H'), ':00') AS timeRange, SUM(price) AS amount FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'SUCCESS'
AND store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY DATE(ordered_at), DATE_FORMAT(ordered_at, '%H') ORDER BY date, timeRange
SELECT P.payment_type AS type, SUM(P.payment_amount) AS amount FROM stores S INNER JOIN payments P ON S.store_id = P.store_id WHERE S.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY P.payment_type
SELECT NVL(SUM(C.paid_money), 0) AS cardPrice FROM payments P INNER JOIN cards C ON P.payment_id = C.payment_id WHERE P.order_id = #{orderId}
